items.title: 68002_Benny Waters oral history interview
items.q: listened to all these other cats, Frankie Trumbauer and all these guys like that

ctx.x: Yeah, sure, well you see, because it's just like - you see, improvising, you don't play like Louis Armstrong or Sidney Bechet to sound good, you see what I mean? Because you can sound good without - I could even say that Bill had a kind of original style and so did I, particularly at that period on the alto saxophone. I sound more like somebody now because I came to New York and was associated with Benny Carter, worked with Benny Carter, worked with Earl Bostic, worked with Johnny Hodg[es] - listened to all these…
